records.title: STATUS OF DOMESTIC AIRPORT AT AMBALA
details:
(a) to (d) An amount of Rs. 25 crores has been sanctioned for the development of Ambala Airport. The Civil Enclave has been developed and the security clearances and
 documentation are currently being processed by the State Government. Commencement of flights is subject to readiness of the airport.
